neonGlow.toggle.title: Neon Glow: Toggle
neonGlow.enable.title: Neon Glow: Enable
neonGlow.disable.title: Neon Glow: Disable
neonGlow.install.title: Neon Glow: Patch the workbench bundle
neonGlow.remove.title: Neon Glow: Restore the original bundle
neonGlow.status.title: Neon Glow: Show status
neonGlow.preset.title: Neon Glow: Choose a preset
neonGlow.glowLayers.markdownDescription: Glow layers per token. **The most costly setting** - fewer layers are much faster on dense files.
neonGlow.maxBlur.markdownDescription: Largest blur radius, in px. Lower it to narrow the glow and make it faster.
neonGlow.brightness.markdownDescription: Overall glow brightness. `0` turns the glow off.
neonGlow.minChroma.markdownDescription: How vivid a colour must be to glow. Raise it to keep plain text from glowing.
neonGlow.chromaSpan.markdownDescription: How quickly the glow gets stronger as colours get more vivid.
neonGlow.floor.markdownDescription: Glow strength for colours that are only just vivid enough.
neonGlow.minLightness.markdownDescriptio: Colours darker than this don't glow.
neonGlow.cursorTrail.markdownDescription: Time for the caret to slide and leave a trail, in ms. `0` is off; try `45`.
neonGlow.saveShake.markdownDescription: Screen shake on save, in px. **Leave it at `0` if you use `#files.autoSave#`.**
neonGlow.findGlow.markdownDescription: Glow on find results, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.selectionGlow.markdownDescripti: Glow on selected text, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.occurrenceGlow.markdownDescript: Glow on the word under the caret and its other occurrences, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.gutterGlow.markdownDescription: Glow on the gutter's change bars, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.bracketMatchGlow.markdownDescri: Glow on the matching bracket box, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.squiggleGlow.markdownDescriptio: Glow on error and warning squiggles, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.diffGlow.markdownDescription: Glow on changed words in a diff, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.lineHighlightGlow.markdownDescr: Glow on the debugger's stopped line and jump targets, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.breakpointGlow.markdownDescript: Glow on breakpoints, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.snippetGlow.markdownDescription: Glow on a snippet's tabstops, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.renameGlow.markdownDescription: Glow on the `F2` rename box, in px. `0` turns it off.
neonGlow.breathe.markdownDescription: Slow pulse on what is waiting for you, like the current find match. One breath in ms; `0` is off.
neonGlow.caretArc.markdownDescription: Effect drawn along the caret's path when it moves.
neonGlow.caretArcColor.markdownDescripti: Colour of the caret arc: `cursor` follows the theme's caret colour, or a hex such as `#ff2f92` (settings.json offers a picker).
neonGlow.caretArcColor.patternErrorMessa: Use cursor, or a hex colour such as #ff2f92.
neonGlow.caretArcMinJump.markdownDescrip: Smallest caret move that draws an effect, in px.
neonGlow.caretArcDuration.markdownDescri: How long the effect lasts, in ms.
neonGlow.caretArcOnDrag.markdownDescript: Also draw the effect while dragging a selection.
